lines.zh: 翅膀一开一合，我在草上飘
lines.en: Wings opening and closing, I drift over the grass

lines.zh: 翅膀上有眼斑，吓唬天敌用
lines.en: Eye spots on my wings, to startle predators

lines.zh: 平原上风很顺，我飞得轻
lines.en: The plains wind is kind, I fly light

lines.zh: 我停在一朵兰花上，吸了两口
lines.en: I stop on an orchid and sip twice
Slow wingbeats keep me unnoticed

lines.zh: 我从一株草尖跳到另一株
lines.en: I flit from one grass tip to the next
The days on the savanna are long

lines.zh: 我飞过的地方，花会结果
lines.en: Where I fly, flowers set seed

lines.zh: 橙色翅膀在阳光下很亮
lines.en: My orange wings are bright in the sun

lines.zh: 我绕着花丛转，不碰叶子
lines.en: I circle the flowers without touching leaves
I rise a little, the wind is steadier

lines.zh: 我落在一根花蕊上，停了一会儿
lines.en: I settle on a stamen and pause

lines.zh: 我在草原上飞，一天能过很多花
lines.en: Over the savanna I pass many flowers a day

lines.zh: 花上落了点粉，我又飞走了
lines.en: A little pollen settles, and I fly on
I skirt a web and go around

lines.zh: 中午的风硬，我贴着草飞
lines.en: The noon wind is stiff, I fly low
I close my wings and rest on the flower

lines.zh: 花纹在荫凉里不那么亮
lines.en: The pattern is dimmer in the shade
I unroll my curled mouthpart
There is still dew on the petals

lines.zh: 没有风，我就安静地待着
lines.en: With no wind, I stay quiet
I sun myself and my wings open slowly
One flower can hold me a long while
My life is not long, but I am in no hurry
The heart of the bloom is warm

lines.zh: 我在花瓣上留下一点粉
lines.en: I leave a trace of powder on the petal
A bee passed and I gave way
These flowers are at their best

lines.zh: 你停在花旁边，我就落在你手背上
lines.en: You stopped by the flowers, so I landed on your hand

lines.zh: 翅膀上的眼斑，能吓你一下吗
lines.en: Can the eye spots on my wings startle you
Your nose is very near me
I am so light you cannot feel me
Do not pinch, my wings tear at a touch

lines.zh: 我落在你的袖口上，歇一下
lines.en: I rest on your cuff a moment

lines.zh: 你身上的颜色，和花不一样
lines.en: Your colors are not like flowers
I circled you twice

lines.zh: 你抬手的时候，风把我吹偏了
lines.en: When you raised your hand, the wind pushed me off

lines.zh: 你看见我翅上的眼睛了吗
lines.en: Did you see the eyes on my wings
A hole in my wing
I dropped down into the grass
Scales scattered along the way

lines.zh: 左边翅膀没力气，飞不直
lines.en: My left wing has no strength; I can't fly straight

lines.zh: 翅膀上的眼斑花了一半
lines.en: Half of an eye spot is ruined
I huddle in the flower's heart
This wound keeps me from flying
I press to the leaf's back and move slowly
My life was short to begin with

lines.zh: 我的翅膜被擦掉一层粉
lines.en: A layer of scale is rubbed off my wing membrane
The flower in your hand, was it picked

lines.zh: 我落在花瓣上，吸了一口
lines.en: I landed on the petal and sipped
There is still nectar, perfect
Hold the flower up, I can reach it
I take nothing but nectar
This flower has gone faint
I will try another, bring that one

lines.zh: 你的手上没有花，不用伸
lines.en: Your hand is empty, no need to offer it
When the flower wilts the nectar goes
A good flower lets the wind carry its scent

lines.zh: 你一动，我就被风带开了
lines.en: You moved and the air carried me off

lines.zh: 翅膀碰了一下你的手指
lines.en: My wing brushed your finger
I fell to the ground and climbed back

lines.zh: 这一下，我的鳞粉掉了一些
lines.en: That shook off some of my wing scales

lines.zh: 你退开一点，让我有地方飞
lines.en: Step back and give me room to fly
I cling to a blade of grass until you go

lines.zh: 我这么小，撞你也没感觉
lines.en: I am this small, hitting you means nothing

lines.zh: 你踩着影子过来，我先飞了
lines.en: Your shadow came first, so I flew
There is a crease in my wing
Touch again and I fly away

lines.zh: 我飞起来，是在找同种的花纹
lines.en: I fly to find my own pattern
The eye spots are how we know each other
I circled it once
There is someone else on that flower
My life is short, I do not want to wait
The wind scattered the scent
We only meet on flowers
It flew off, I stayed
The flowers here are good
There is still tomorrow

lines.zh: 花瓣上落了个东西，我推了推
lines.en: Something landed on the petal, I nudged it
I cannot carry it, it is heavier than I am
I hooked at it with a foot
This is not nectar, I leave it
It rolled off the flower
I rested beside it and looked a long while
Paper? Its color is like mine
The wind took it, I do not chase
No space for it on the bloom
Go on, take it, I am watching
Something is nearing the flowers
I close my wings and become a patch of color
I shift to the back of the flower
That shadow is far too large for me
I take flight first, then look
The stem swayed
I land on a leaf and freeze
Wings closed, eye spots facing out

lines.zh: 我听见花丛上方有呼吸
lines.en: I hear breathing above the flowers
You are still walking this way
I fly low along the grass tips
There are no other butterflies here
I stop, and you stop too
When the wind turns, I turn with it
I can hide on a leaf a long while
Your shadow keeps moving

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，不乱动
lines.en: I count your steps without stirring
The color of the flowers shields me
The stem hides half of me
Come closer and I fly upward

lines.zh: 我撞在你脸上，一点分量都没有
lines.en: I hit your face with no weight at all
My wings brushed your eyes
I pushed with my feet
It is not a blow, only a push
I bite you and cannot break skin
I scatter my scales into the air

lines.zh: 你眨了眼，我就趁机飞开
lines.en: You blinked and I slipped away
My wing taps your nose
I dart in and withdraw
That is the whole of my strength
An orange point has joined the flowers
I open my wings and flash once
The wind carried me from far off

lines.zh: 一朵兰花上多了个影子
lines.en: A shadow has landed on an orchid

lines.zh: 虫卵在叶背上，已经孵了
lines.en: The eggs on the leaf's back have hatched
I rise out of the grass
The plains day is just beginning

lines.zh: 翅膀还是软的，我慢慢扇
lines.en: My wings are still soft, I fan them slowly
This patch of flowers has nobody in it
I settle on the highest flower

lines.zh: 热气一冲，翅膀就皱起来了
lines.en: The heat rushed up and my wings crinkled

lines.zh: 我从花上掉下来，掉在土上
lines.en: I fell from the flower onto the soil
The dew ran deeper than I guessed
A gust of wind rolled me far away

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过花丛，把花瓣和我的翅膀一起撕了
lines.en: An arrow tore through petal and wing alike
That force left my wings numb
The flower hearts are dry, nothing comes

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整夜没敢动
lines.en: A flash of lightning and I did not dare move all night
There is not even one flower here
